app: AI-Weld Settings Library / Vectis Weld Recipe Control
purpose: Capture mild steel test coupon results before any baseline setting can become an approved or locked weld recipe.

scope_rules.production_lock_rule: A test coupon cannot become a locked recipe automatically. Test result approval is required before a locked_recipe_id can be assigned.

status_controls.locked_recipe_id_rule: Must remain null unless test_status is TEST_COMPLETE_PASS and approval_status is APPROVED_FOR_LOCKING.
